response.sql: WITH team_avg AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND g <> 0 THEN CAST(w AS REAL) / g END) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_rate FROM team_avg) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM team_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_rate) IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
